Package persist.lint.api.spi

Interface NamedObjectParserFactory

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceLinterFactory
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaNamedObjectParserFactory, LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory
public interface NamedObjectParserFactory extends PersistenceLinterFactory
Factory for creating NamedObjectParser instances.

Implementations are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism. Each implementation declares the persistence namespace it supports (e.g. "javax" or "jakarta") so that the correct parser strategy can be resolved for the target JPA specification version.

Since:
2.0.0

    • newNamedObjectParser

      NamedObjectParser newNamedObjectParser(List<String> discoveredClassNames)
      Creates a new NamedObjectParser configured with the given entity class names.
      Parameters:
      discoveredClassNames - fully qualified class names of the JPA entities to register in the metamodel
      Returns:
      a ready-to-use named object parser; the caller is responsible for closing it (preferably via try-with-resources)

    • newNamedObjectParserFactory

      static NamedObjectParserFactory newNamedObjectParserFactory(String jpaVersion)
      Discovers and returns the NamedObjectParserFactory implementation that matches the given JPA specification version.

      The version string is mapped to a persistence namespace ("javax" for versions 2.0–2.2, "jakarta" for versions 3.0–3.2) and the matching factory is located via the ServiceLoader API.

      Parameters:
      jpaVersion - the JPA specification version (e.g. "2.2" or "3.1")
      Returns:
      the factory implementation for the requested version
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is not recognized
      IllegalStateException - if no provider is registered for the resolved namespace
